name: klymbak
description: Replace internal admin panels with an agent that lives in a chat. Vue 3 + Node, built on the pi agent harness.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,console -c blue,green "pnpm --filter acme-api dev" "pnpm --filter acme-console dev"
scripts.dev:react: concurrently -k -n api,react -c blue,cyan "pnpm --filter acme-api dev" "pnpm --filter react-console dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,console,site -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter acme-api dev" "pnpm --filter acme-console dev" "pnpm --filter site dev"
